summary: Assertio Holdings, Inc. entered into a definitive Agreement and Plan of Merger with Zydus Worldwide DMCC, under which Zydus will acquire all outstanding shares of Assertio common stock via a cash tender offer of $23.50 per share, followed by a merger. The board unanimously approved the deal and recommends shareholders tender. The tender offer is to commence within five business days and remain open for 20 business days. The implied equity value is not stated but based on tendered shares. No premium percentage is given; the per-share price implies a ~XX% premium over recent trading if applicable. The merger will result in Assertio becoming a wholly owned subsidiary of Zydus. Appraisal rights are available under Delaware law. Watch for regulatory clearance timing and any competing bids.
